 Search The Site Morgan Wallen 2-Night Concert at Highmark Stadium in Buffalo, New York Morgan Wallen 2-Night Concert at Highmark Stadium in Buffalo, New York
 Rob Banks Rob Banks Published: November 12, 2026 2218355287 Share on Facebook 
 Morgan Wallen is coming 2 nights to Buffalo, New York at Highmark Stadium and he is bringing Stella Lefty, Thomas Rhett, Brooks and Dunn and Cole Swindell. Wallen will bring his tour to the stadium on July 23 and 24, 2027 next Summer to Buffalo. It is called the LAST TIME I CHECKED Tour .
 When do tickets go on sale for Morgan Wallen in Buffalo?
 There will be presale registration beginning today and there will be multiple presales happening before the general onsale of tickets for the Last Time I Checked Tour.
 How to get presale tickets: 
 1.) Register on Morgan Wallen's website
 2.) They will send you the presale code and info when tickets are available for presale
 Presale will happen for 2 DIFFERENT DAYS: 
 If you want to go to NIGHT #1 (with Thomas Rhett), presale is November 17th.
 If you want to go to NIGHT #2 (with Brooks & Dunn), presale is November 18th.
 Public on sale for tickets is next Friday, November 20, 2026. 
 Morgan Wallen is coming to Buffalo, New York's Highmark Stadium f or the LAST TIME I CHECKED TOUR.

 Who is opening up for Morgan Wallen in 2027?
 Morgan Wallen is the latest act to be added to the list of concerts that are happening at Highmark Stadium in 2027 and the first concert that will be outside of the month of June. So far, Noah Kahan, Metallica, Zach Bryan and John Fogerty and Kenny Chesney and Eric Church have been announced for next June.
 You would have to think that the Morgan Wallen could potentially be the final concerts at Highmark Stadium for the Summer because the Buffalo Bills have to return in August for practice and preseason.
 Who will do the walkout with Morgan Wallen in Buffalo, New York in July of 2027? Could it be Josh Allen? It seems like Josh would never align himself with other celebrities like that. But notable country fans in Buffalo are Dalton Kincaid from the Buffalo Bills or Beck Malenstyn from the Buffalo Sabres.
